description: btif/src/btif_dm.c in Android before 5.1 does not properly enforce the temporary nature of a Bluetooth pairing, which allows user-assisted remote attackers to bypass intended access restrictions via crafted Bluetooth packets after the tapping of a crafted NFC tag.

title: Anant Labs google-enterprise-connector-dctm sql injection
description: A vulnerability has been found in Anant Labs google-enterprise-connector-dctm up to 3.2.3 and classified as critical. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality. The manipulation of the argument username/domain leads to sql injection. The patch is named 6fba04f18ab7764002a1da308e7cd9712b501cb7. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue. The associated identifier of this vulnerability is VDB-218911.
